title: EU AI Act Article 12 Log Schema Checker
description: Maps a declared AI system log schema against EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) Article 12(2)'s three event categories (Art 79(1)/43(4) risk identification, Art 72 post-market monitoring, Art 26(5) operation monitoring), Article 12(3)'s four minimum elements for Annex III point 1(a) remote biometric identification systems, and Article 19's six-month retention floor and financial-institution documentation duty, returning a gap list with the cited clause per gap. Deterministic, client-side, zero PII.

logsAuto.description: System technically allows automatic recording of events (Art 12(1))

logsLifetime.description: Logging covers the entire system lifetime (Art 12(1))

eventsTimestamped.description: Events recorded automatically at the latest when each event occurs (Art 12(2) chapeau)

isRemoteBiometricId.description: Annex III point 1(a) remote biometric identification gate for Art 12(3)

bioStartEnd.description: Usage start/end date and time recorded (Art 12(3)(a))

retentionMonths.description: Declared retention period in months (Art 19(1) floor is six)

retentionLawOverride.description: Applicable Union or national law provides otherwise (Art 19(1) exception)

isFinancialInstitution.description: Provider is a financial institution or otherwise subject to internal-governance requirements (Art 19(2))

governanceDocs.description: Logs kept as part of internal-governance documentation (Art 19(2))

schemaText.description: Free structure input: synthetic log schema field names or JSON sample

gaps.description: Gap rows, each with the governing clause citation

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_eu_ai_act_article12_log_schema
mcp_tool_definition.description: Maps a declared AI system log schema against EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) Article 12(2)'s three event categories (Art 79(1)/43(4) risk identification, Art 72 post-market monitoring, Art 26(5) operation monitoring), Article 12(3)'s four minimum elements for Annex III point 1(a) remote biometric identification systems, and Article 19's six-month retention floor and financial-institution documentation duty, returning a gap list with the cited clause per gap. Deterministic, browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/666-eu-ai-act-article12-log-schema-checker.html for interactive use.
